title: Factors Affecting Entrepreneurs

alignment.course_outcome: CO1 - Discuss the fundamentals of entrepreneurship

template_credit: Numbered tabs interaction template by Angelica Serratos Moreno

illustration.subject: A founder at the centre of four interconnected forces: capital and market, family and community, confidence and learning, policy and institutional support
illustration.composition: Circular ecosystem wheel with four visually distinct quadrants
illustration.style: Organic systems illustration with botanical geometry and warm material textures

case: Case connection: A technically sound campus product may still stall when testing facilities, early customers, working capital or regulatory guidance are unavailable.
misconception: Common mistake: Blaming failure on personality alone or assuming a government scheme automatically creates entrepreneurial capability.
application: Map one proposed venture against the four factor groups and identify the single most limiting constraint.

sources.locator: Unit I, I.4 Factors affecting entrepreneurs
